limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board work performed.
Behavior before the first synchronous reset is unspecified by the problem and is not asserted by the testbench.
interface_cycle_semantics: Original one-bit ports preserved. Bits sampled on positive clock edges. Output asserts immediately after sampling the final bit of 1101 and stays asserted until a positive edge with reset high.
implementation: Five-state prefix FSM with absorbing FOUND state; explicit if/else next-state assignments; three-bit enum; no added ports or pipeline latency.
verification: Independent four-bit history oracle checks all 4096 twelve-bit streams, reset at each prefix length, reset priority, output stability before sampling edges, and sticky output. Bounded timeout and fatal mismatch checks included.
static_review: Complete combinational assignments, nonblocking state register, synchronous active-high reset, and single driver reviewed.
